name: no Path: Failure navigate-to-path/no-path and Error says why — with no window too, the check comes first
because: :150-160 run before the window check at :199

name: no window (a server render): Navigate is Unchanged and nothing is pushed
the default (hash) path type: the filled Path is pushed after a #, popstate is dispatched, Done
because: :172 fills {id}; :176-177 unset is hash; :218-222 push, dispatch, Done

name: the path type: the filled Path is pushed as the path
because: :177-178 — anything but unset or 'hash' is the path

name: two presses in one frame: ONE push, two Done
because: :129-141 the coalescing guard drops the second navigation; :122-125 keeps both tokens; :222 answers both

name: the frame's FINAL Path is the one navigated to: a press, then Path changes in the same frame
because: :131 scheduleAfterInputsHaveUpdated — the navigation runs after the frame's inputs land

name: a placeholder never set is replaced by nothing
a placeholder used twice is filled both times
because: :162-173 — every occurrence is matched and each replace takes the first one left

name: a parameter value holding $& is inserted as written (v2, D20)
because: a function replacement: v1 expanded $&, $$, $` and $' in a value, so $& put the placeholder back (D20, fixed in P109 ISL-028)

name: Query: each name with a value is appended unencoded; a name with no value is left out (hash type: the query before the #)
Query with the path type: path, then ?query; a null value is left out, a value with & is encoded (v2, D21)
because: null is unset like undefined; name and value through encodeURIComponent, as the Router decodes them (D21, fixed in P109 ISL-028 — v1 appended 'page=null' and an unencoded 'sort=a&b')

name: Query with the hash type: a value with # and a name with a space are encoded, so the hash still starts the page (v2, D21)
because: v1 put '?q=a#b#/list' in the address: the browser read the hash from the first #, so the router read the wrong page (D21, fixed in P109 ISL-028)

name: an empty Path is a navigation to the bare #
Open in new tab, a person's press: window.open(url, '_blank') with no features, Done — nothing pushed
Open in new tab, a press the graph made: the open is made, the blocker hands back null, Failure navigate-to-path/blocked
because: :205-215 — world.ts LOCATION: no activation, a new window, null

name: Open in new tab reads truthiness: 'yes' opens a new tab
Error keeps its last message: a blocked press, then a push that is Done, leaves 'blocked' on Error
C24 — a Path that is not text (null) is read as no Path: Failure navigate-to-path/no-path
because: P107-C24, ruled 2026-10-05 "Treat it as no path", fixed in P109 ISL-026; the runtime once threw at :162 (`.match` on null) inside the frame-end callback and the press was never answered

name: C25 — the path type with a Path on another origin: the push is made, the browser refuses it, Failure navigate-to-path/refused
because: the browser refuses pushState to another origin with a SecurityError; the node catches it and answers Failure (C25, fixed in P109 ISL-028 — it used to throw out of the frame-end callback, the press never answered)

name: the hash type keeps another origin's address inside the hash: pushed, Done
